cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. It is. I'd like to hand it over beside my paintings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hanging buys forgiveness. Stay to take them down and I'll stop mentioning the argument to Mum.
